turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have a call at 4:40, Hale, so let's not waste it. Owen found out about a zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me. Who decided, and did anyone hear Owen first?
I'm fine standing. I asked you who decided, Hale.
You were so gracious on the phone. I'd been dreading this and you made it easy.
Don't manage me, Hale. I'm still waiting to hear who entered that zero, and whether anyone spoke to Owen before it went in.
So can we agree the zero stands and move on? You strike me as someone who knows which battles are worth picking.
No. You said "the zero stands" without answering a single question I've asked, and I'm writing that down. This is exactly the battle I'm picking, Hale.
